name: Whatagraph
description:
Connect Claude to Whatagraph's governed marketing data hub. Ask questions in natural language to pull campaign results, compare performance across channels, and spot trends, without opening a dashboard.

Unlike connecting AI directly to raw channel APIs, Whatagraph MCP sits on top of a data model that has already blended, normalized, and aggregated your data across all sources. The number Claude returns matches what's in your reports.

What you can do:
— Query spend, ROAS, CAC, impressions, and conversions across all connected channels
— Compare performance across clients, brands, or locations
— Get cross-channel morning briefings without logging in
— Browse your reporting structure: spaces, reports, tabs, and widgets
— Explore connected data sources with their available metrics and dimensions

Data access: Read-only. Inherits your Whatagraph role-based permissions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Whatagraph to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Whatagraph to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.whatagraph.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Whatagraph MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whatagraph lists 73 MCP tools, including delete-agents, delete-automations, delete-blends, delete-conversations, delete-custom-dimensions, delete-custom-metrics, delete-destinations, delete-filters, delete-goals, delete-overviews, delete-report-tabs, and delete-reports.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Whatagraph?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Whatagraph in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Whatagraph requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Whatagraph is developed by Whatagraph B. V.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
